Azure Cobalt 200 VMs Launch: List Price Runs 40% Above Cobalt 100, So Speedup Must Top 1.4x

Azure Cobalt 200 VMs became generally available on Nov. 17 in 14 regions, with the 4-vCPU Linux size listed at $0.196 per hour in East US, 40% above Cobalt 100. Microsoft claims up to 50% better performance, so workloads need a per-vCPU speedup above 1.4x to cut cost per task. This covers break-even
